## POST `/api/instances/snap/name:{name}/action/attach`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Attach the snapshot so hosts can access it. Attaching a snapshot makes the snapshot accessible to configured hosts for restoring files and data. The host must have access to protection data in order to access the snapshot.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | Snapshot name. |

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `copyName` | string | Name of the snapshot copy created before the Attach operation occurs. |
| `hostAccess` | array of object | List of hosts with access levels each should have to the snapshot. Only read and write access levels are permitted as host settings. If specified - snapshot will be attached to dynamic Snapshot Mount Point. |
| `force` | boolean | If specified, attach the snap regardless of whether this snap has dependent Thin Clones. |

**Responses:** `200` OK body fields: `updated`, `content`

## POST `/api/instances/snap/name:{name}/action/copy`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Copy a snapshot. If source snapshot is attached, the new copy has the same source snapshot as a parent and is marked as not modified. If source snapshot is not attached, the behavior depends on child parameter. By default, child parameter is false and the new copy is created as a sibling of source snapshot.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | Snapshot name. |

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `copyName` | string | Base name for the new snapshot copies. |
| `numCopies` | integer (unsigned int[32]) | Number of snapshot copies to make. |
| `copyStartNum` | integer (unsigned int[32]) | Starting number for the group of copies. This number gets appended to the name specified in the copyName argument to form the name of the first snapshot copy. The system increments the number for each new snapshot. |
| `child` | boolean | If true for an unattached snapshot, the new copy has the source snapshot as a parent. If false, the new copy is created as a sibling of the source snapshot. Setting this parameter to false for an attached snapshot… |

**Responses:** `200` OK body fields: `updated`, `content`
